entry.title: Bränder efter drönarattacker i Kiev
entry.summary:
• I Ukraina uppges det brinna på flera håll i Kiev efter att ryska drönare attackerat huvudstaden.

  • Hur stora skadorna är undersöks fortfarande, men drönarna ska bland annat ha träffat ett bostadshus som börjat brinna i östra delen av Kiev – och det ska också brinna i en byggnad i västra Kiev.

  • ”Vi gjorde en bedrift. Ett hus finns ju på månen”, säger han.

entry.title: Kritik mot klassiska studenttraditionen: ”Ska bort”
entry.summary:
• En tradition i många avgångsklasser är att dela ut papperstallrikar med så kallade “klassens” på, där eleverna får var sitt epitet som deras klasskamrater har bestämt.

entry.title: Natochefen: Föreslår fem procent som mål

  • Rutte ville inte säga när målet ska nås. Men där har man tidigare pratat om 2030 eller 2032.

entry.title: dmitriid is being grumpy
entry.summary: dmitriid: I propose a new design term: "total design failure". Definition: when every single person in the chain responsible for shipping a product looks at objectively horrendous design decisions and goes: yup, this looks good to me, release this. Designers, developers, product managers, testers, quality assurance... *everyone*. I nominate Peugeot as the first example in this category. Every interaction is accompanied by animation that takes several seconds to complete. Since these animations are completely unnecessary the few hardware buttons switch between screens instantaneously. The cherry on top is that it takes over a second—with a loading animation!—to change temperature by one degree. And no one in the whole decision chain looked at it and said, "this is unacceptable".

entry.title: Slow image loading
entry.summary: May 15, 03:01 UTC Resolved - We haven't had image delivery slownesses for a few weeks now, and we consider the issue definitely resolved. Mar 30, 18:36 UTC Identified - While we are managing to serve some of the image traffic, clearly we aren't keeping up with demand and loading times are still very slow. We have however identified the bottleneck and will be working to address it. Mar 30, 17:00 UTC Update - Since things have been fine for now, we will keep monitoring but consider the issue presumably fixed. Mar 29, 00:19 UTC Monitoring - A fix has been implemented, but we will need to wait for a similar failure as the last times to see it perform live before we judge it as sufficient. Mar 17, 20:01 UTC Investigating - Image loading is extremely slow again in some region. While we have a rough idea of what is the cause, it is not so easy to address. We're actively working on it.

entry.title: Titan forecast: partly cloudy with a chance of methane showers
entry.summary: A science team has combined data from the NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope and the Keck II telescope to see evidence of cloud convection on Saturn’s moon Titan in the northern hemisphere for the first time. Most of Titan’s lakes and seas are located in that hemisphere, and are likely replenished by an occasional rain of methane and ethane. Webb also has detected a key carbon-containing molecule that gives insight into the chemical processes in Titan’s complex atmosphere.
